mandatoryCriteria: Bounded consistent snapshot: GET /api/v1/boards/:boardId returns snapshot object with board metadata, filters, asOfDate, totals, columns, and people
Accurate active vs matching counts: totals.activeCardCount counts all active cards; totals.matchingCardCount counts cards matching filters; excludes trashed cards
Column card nesting: Each column in the snapshot contains cards array bounded by cardLimitPerColumn (default 10, max 15) and nextCursor if more exist
People disclosure: Returns distinct PersonDisplay records for all card assignees and creators referenced on the board
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Board snapshot query with filters and count contracts.
